description.sl: Kaj jemo v vasi: kruh, mleko, sadje in koroške jedi, od kasnudeln do reindlinga. Oma Resi pove, kako se jim reče v Avstriji.
description.en: What the village eats: bread, milk, fruit and Carinthian dishes, from Kasnudeln to Reindling. Oma Resi tells you what Austrians call them.
description.it: Che cosa si mangia in paese: pane, latte, frutta e piatti della Carinzia, dai Kasnudeln al Reindling. Oma Resi ti dice come si chiamano in Austria.

words.example_de: Zum Frühstück esse ich eine Semmel.
words.example_en: I have a roll for breakfast.
words.note: Austrian; in much of Germany: das Brötchen.
words.note_sl: Avstrijsko; v večjem delu Nemčije: das Brötchen.
words.note_it: Austriaco; in gran parte della Germania: das Brötchen.

words.example_de: Die Milch ist von der Alm.
words.example_en: The milk is from the mountain pasture.

words.example_de: Der Käse kommt aus dem Gailtal.
words.example_en: The cheese comes from the Gailtal.

words.example_it: Nei Kasnudeln ci vanno le patate.
words.note: Austrian (literally: earth apple); in Germany: die Kartoffel.
words.note_sl: Avstrijsko (dobesedno: zemeljsko jabolko); v Nemčiji: die Kartoffel.
words.note_it: Austriaco (letteralmente: mela di terra); in Germania: die Kartoffel.

words.note: Austrian; in Germany: die Tomate. The Slovene paradižnik is the same word.
words.note_sl: Avstrijsko; v Nemčiji: die Tomate. Slovenski paradižnik je ista beseda.

words.example_de: Oma macht die Fülle mit Topfen.
words.example_en: Grandma makes the filling with curd cheese.
words.example_it: La nonna fa il ripieno con la ricotta.
words.note_it: Austriaco; in Germania: der Quark. È simile alla ricotta.

words.note: Carinthia's dish: pasta filled with curd cheese, potato and mint, the edge crimped by hand (krendeln).
words.note_sl: Koroška jed: testo, polnjeno s skuto, krompirjem in meto, rob ročno nazobčan (krendeln).
words.note_it: Il piatto della Carinzia: pasta ripiena di ricotta, patate e menta, con il bordo chiuso a mano (krendeln).

words.example_de: Am Sonntag backt Oma einen Reindling.
words.example_en: On Sunday Grandma bakes a Reindling.
words.example_it: Domenica la nonna fa un Reindling.
words.note: A yeast cake with cinnamon, sugar and raisins, baked in a round pan (das Reindl).
words.note_sl: Kvašeno pecivo s cimetom, sladkorjem in rozinami, pečeno v okrogli posodi (das Reindl), podobno šarklju.
words.note_it: Un dolce lievitato con cannella, zucchero e uvetta, cotto in una teglia rotonda (das Reindl).

words.example_de: Der Fisch ist aus dem See.
words.example_en: The fish is from the lake.

words.example_de: Am See essen wir ein Eis.
words.example_en: We have an ice cream by the lake.
words.note: Das Eis is ice cream and also ice.
words.note_sl: Das Eis je sladoled in tudi led.
words.note_it: Das Eis è il gelato e anche il ghiaccio.

words.example_de: Zur Jause gibt es Brot mit Speck.
words.example_sl: Za malico je kruh s špehom.
words.example_en: For a snack there's bread with bacon.
words.example_it: Per merenda c'è pane e speck.
words.note: Austrian: a small meal, often bread with Speck and cheese. The Slovene južina comes from the same word.
words.note_sl: Avstrijsko: majhen obrok, pogosto kruh s špehom in sirom. Iz iste besede je slovenska južina.
words.note_it: Austriaco: un piccolo pasto, spesso pane con speck e formaggio.
Gli austriaci dicono anche das Nachtmahl.

words.note: Literally: I have hunger. Thirst too: Ich habe Durst.
words.note_sl: Dobesedno: imam lakoto. Tudi žejo: Ich habe Durst.
words.note_it: Come in italiano: ho fame. Anche la sete: Ich habe Durst.

words.note: One thing: es schmeckt; several: sie schmecken.
words.note_sl: Za eno stvar: es schmeckt; za več: sie schmecken.
words.note_it: Per una cosa: es schmeckt; per più cose: sie schmecken.
